craft_notes: Sthāyin: restraint — manifest preferred. Rows: ban then order. Read aloud: held hand.

lines: Now for the emblem: raise no sign with hidden spells —
least of all the plain. Where signs stand raised of old, in coming-and-going order, worship — the old ones bearing all.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atha liṅge tatra na rahasyamantraiḥ liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayet viśeṣāt vyaktam iti pūrvapratiṣṭhiteṣu āvāhanavisarjanakrameṇa pūjāṃ kuryāt ādhāratayā
